judge._comment: LLM used ONLY for labeled synthesis (sia ponder) and take grading. backend: codex | claude (uses your existing CLI subscription; auto-detected when unset). model is passed to that CLI.

senses._comment: Optional integrations (jackal/sekhmet/custos/aegis/worldline/guardian) auto-activate when their data exists; list names here to force-disable any sense.

custom_senses._comment: Point SIA at YOUR programs. type: lines | jsonl. 'match' is a regex; for jsonl, 'field' selects the message field.
custom_senses.name: example-app

chains._comment: Extra signed evidence chains to re-verify each sweep: name, ledger path, and the argv of ITS OWN verifier (exit 0 = pass).
